meta.title: AI VIDEO TOP
meta.subtitle: Latest on top · feed ordered by publish date

videos.title: TARU
videos.description: On a jungle planet where the rain never stops, mysterious orbs hold the key to an enigmatic gate. Martial arts, sword fights, strange creatures and bamboo forests, told without a word. Made mainly with Seedance 2.5 via Dreamina, plus Veo 3.1 and Nano Banana Pro.

videos.title: Nexus Ep 7 — Dino Demolition Squad
videos.highlight: Weekly episodes from the Nexus universe
videos.description: Thump rides a spitting dinosaur and fires exploding pustules off a living mortar named Brontenheimer. The empire hired him to win the war, but he keeps blowing up its own soldiers. Fantasy comedy episode while the Nexus feature is in the works.

videos.title: OTTO
videos.description: A household robot starts asking what it means to be human. A program called OtherLife promises him a real human life in simulation: childhood, first love, a family of his own.

videos.title: THE LAST DELIVERY
videos.description: A delivery robot keeps walking its route through a dead world, carrying a package for a recipient who died years ago. A starving dog starts following it. Blender plus AI image and video, hand-edited and sound-designed.

videos.title: Goldfish Mayhem — Beyond the Loop S2
videos.description: On a fictionalised street in southern China, BOBO, Fengshui Girl and Xixili try to rescue their foster mother, Auntie Fen, and uncover a data-immortality experiment run by the city's elite. Kung fu, absurdist humour and street mythology, inspired by Junie Lau's upbringing in Foshan and her love of Hong Kong cinema. Final film of Wonder Studios' anthology Beyond the Loop S2.

videos.title: Junkyard King — Chapter 3: "The Other Side"
videos.description: Chapter 3 of Henry Daubrez's animated series (produced by ODD KID): Artie, Kai and Socket cross the gate into Avalon, a strangely beautiful world of new creatures, clues and one very big fight.

videos.title: THE FAILURE
videos.description: Short claymation-style AI film by Jesús Terrada: a plasticine character with antennae, a suitcase and a puffer jacket sets off among the crowd. 'I say you should go your own way.'

videos.title: REVIVER — Trailer
videos.highlight: The Dor Brothers · new film coming soon
videos.description: Trailer for 'Reviver', the upcoming film from The Dor Brothers, created by Aleksey. Coming soon.

videos.title: KITA — Beyond the Loop S2
videos.highlight: Grammy-nominated Jidenna's debut as a filmmaker · stop-motion look
videos.description: An elderly, disabled Nigerian tech entrepreneur lives alone in a near-future city. When a malfunctioning delivery robot starts turning up at the same time every afternoon, he decides it must be choosing him. Fifth film of Wonder Studios' anthology Beyond the Loop S2. Jidenna designed the world, wrote, directed and scored it, with no coding background, to make the stop-motion film with Black characters that rarely gets greenlit.

videos.title: La triste figura (The Sorrowful Figure) — Contanimation TV #1
videos.highlight: Contanimation TV #1 · produced with Magnific Originals
videos.description: An 11-minute AI animated comedy adventure inspired by Don Quixote's charge against the windmills. Sancho Panza starts to suspect his master is far more delusional than he thought, until Don Quixote spots a line of giants only he can see. First short of Contanimation TV, an animated anthology produced with Magnific Originals.

videos.title: THE PROMPTER
videos.highlight: Higgsfield Global Film Festival 2026 · entry · 260K+ views
videos.description: An AI researcher generates artificial worlds to harvest genuine human emotion, until his experiment slips beyond his control. A psychological sci-fi short made entirely with AI: every image, voice and sound.

videos.title: Critterz — Remastered with Sora
videos.highlight: Seed of OpenAI's AI-animated feature (delayed from Cannes 2026)
videos.description: Shot-for-shot Sora remake of the award-winning animated short, side by side with the original. It is the seed of 'Critterz', the OpenAI-backed feature (budget under $30M, nine-month production) written by the Paddington in Peru writers, which was set to debut at Cannes 2026 and has since been delayed.

videos.title: Fruit Love Island — Episodes 1-9
videos.highlight: AI micro-drama phenomenon · 3.1M followers in 9 days
videos.description: A reality-show parody starring anthropomorphic fruit, released on TikTok by @ai.cinema021 on March 13, 2026. It gained over 3.1 million followers in nine days, with single episodes above 10 million views, and spawned a whole genre of AI fruit micro-dramas. Originally on TikTok; this is a YouTube compilation.

videos.title: Tom Cruise vs. Brad Pitt — the Seedance 2.0 clip that shook Hollywood
videos.director: Ruairí Robinson (clip) · report by Inside Edition
videos.highlight: The most viral AI clip of 2026 · 3M+ views on X
videos.description: A 15-second rooftop fistfight between AI versions of Tom Cruise and Brad Pitt, made by Irish filmmaker Ruairí Robinson with a two-line Seedance 2.0 prompt. It triggered statements from SAG-AFTRA and the MPA and a cease-and-desist from Disney. Some argue it was green screen plus face swap. The original was posted on X; this is a news report that shows the clip.

videos.title: BY YOUR SIDE
videos.description: Paris has fallen silent and nature is taking the city back. A municipal service robot keeps cleaning the streets long after civilization is gone, until something starts following him.

videos.title: STILL
videos.description: In the silence of a psychiatric institution, a young man notices something no one else seems to see. A short about memory, music and grief, with a handcrafted stop-motion look.

videos.title: Costa Verde
videos.highlight: Best WAiFF Film + Best Fantasy Film · Runway AIF 2026 Honoree
videos.description: Corsica in the 90s: a boy unboxes his first camera and documents a summer with his grandparents. What begins as play becomes a chronicle of small wonders. Premiered on NOWNESS.

awards.label: World AI Film Festival 2026 · Best WAiFF Film

videos.title: Little Mes
videos.description: A cinematic internal monologue: a man becomes aware of multiple versions of himself, the parallel lives he didn't lead, quietly coexisting at the edge of his present. A Salad Collective production.

videos.title: Tairell Isn't Real
videos.description: Psychological thriller: a hyper-perfect influencer starts to unravel when the internet becomes convinced he isn't real, and he has to face the possibility that they might be right.

videos.title: A Face Only A Mother Could Love
videos.highlight: Double winner: Runway AIF 2026 Grand Prix + Reply AI Film Festival 2026
videos.description: Marcel Dupont moves through Paris with complete confidence while the world moves away from him. A film about two lonely people, one act of courage and an accordion player who plays exactly the right song at the right moment.

videos.title: Nexus — Wet Markets of Kafar
videos.description: Teaser for a hybrid feature film. Models: Octo + Seedance 2.0. Team: PJ Ace, Dan Weller, Karim Youssef, Stephen Quach.

videos.title: Junkyard King — EP1: "Training Day"
videos.highlight: Google Flow's first Filmmaker in Residence
videos.description: EP1 of a two-episode series (~16 min) set in the 80s: Artie, a teenager obsessed with VHS tapes and samurai movies. Made with Google Flow (Veo + Nano Banana).

videos.title: The Chronicles of Bone — Prologue: The Chosen Knight
videos.description: Prologue of a serialized fantasy series. Produced with the Freepik/Magnific suite (routes Kling/Veo/Seedance per shot).

videos.title: The Interview (2026)

videos.description: Official Washed Out music video directed by Paul Trillo; continuous infinite-zoom transitions. The first music video commissioned with Sora.

videos.description: Unofficial Porsche spec ad by László Gaál, viral in January 2025. Google Veo 2.

videos.highlight: Real brand ad made with AI (controversial)
videos.description: Official Coca-Cola holiday ad generated with AI (several studios: Secret Level, Silverside, Wild Card). Single tool unconfirmed.

videos.title: Children of a Dead Star — Trailer
videos.description: Trailer for a short film set in 1979 East Germany: a remote military surveillance station intercepts an alien signal. Tool unconfirmed.

videos.title: Ausencia — GEN:48 Aleph Edition
videos.description: AI-animated short made in 48h for Runway's GEN:48 Aleph challenge; a deeply emotional dialogue sequence. Won Best Animation at the Bionic Awards.

videos.title: El Forastero (The Alien)
videos.description: Dialogue-free concept teaser blending western and sci-fi around an alien stranger; 'Anirreal' aesthetic with hyperrealistic textures.

videos.highlight: Seedance 2.0 demo · AI on the Lot
videos.description: Demo short generated entirely with Seedance 2.0, presented at the AI on the Lot event.

videos.highlight: Fictional live-action trailer · made in 5 days
videos.description: Fictional R-rated trailer for a live-action The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild movie, made in five days with the Freepik suite.

videos.title: Kalshi — AI ad (NBA Finals)
videos.highlight: Viral ad · aired during the NBA Finals
videos.description: Kalshi ad generated with AI (Google Veo 3), chaotic GTA-style scenes, aired during the NBA Finals.

videos.title: World Cup 2026 — The AI Football Movie
videos.description: AI cinematic piece about the 2026 World Cup. Tool unconfirmed.

videos.title: KOI Games — AI Cinematic Film
videos.description: Survival-style AI cinematic with Spanish streamers (Ibai, elXokas, TheGrefg) fighting to stay alive. Tool unconfirmed.

videos.title: The Well
videos.description: Once upon a time, in a snow-covered trailer park, the wolf is found dead at the bottom of a well. A sharp-witted hare starts to investigate, and the truth shifts. Tool unconfirmed.

videos.title: Coca-Cola — Uncanned Emotions (FIFA World Cup 2026)
videos.highlight: World Cup 2026 · criticized for its AI shots
videos.description: Official sponsor spot voiced by commentators Peter Drury (EN) and Luis Omar Tapia (ES). Instead of football, a series of AI shots of Coca-Cola cans being tapped, opened, thrown and spilled. Critics called it flat and generic: a case study of AI as a production shortcut rather than an idea.

videos.title: Pepsi — Football Nation (World Cup 2026)
videos.highlight: World Cup 2026 · 'the AI can still be quite distracting'
videos.description: David Beckham and football banter between fans debating the rules of a 'Football Nation'. Named among the worst World Cup ads of 2026 for its generative AI visuals: less egregious than Coca-Cola's, but still distracting at times.

videos.title: Powerade — Power Your Fate (World Cup 2026)
videos.highlight: World Cup 2026 · players turned into murals, statues and bronze
videos.description: Lamine Yamal and Rodrygo in a poetic take on preparation and discipline: players transform into painted murals, sculpted statues and a bronze stadium facade. Created by WPP Open X. Praised as a surprisingly artistic energy-drink spot.

videos.title: LEGO — Everyone Wants a Piece (World Cup 2026)
videos.highlight: The counterpoint: NO AI · 314M views in 24h
videos.description: Mbappé, Messi, Ronaldo and Vini Jr. all want a piece of the LEGO FIFA World Cup trophy, and they are not alone. Posted with #HonestlyItsnotai: traditional effects and body doubles, no generative AI. 314 million views on players' Instagram accounts in 24 hours. Included as a contrast: the idea beats the tool.

videos.title: WOODNUTS
videos.highlight: Cosmic horror · Thirteen Cycles of Humanity
videos.description: A punch-burn laborer harvesting psychoactive sap in the forests of Jatar is lured into the deep woods and consumed by the forest's memories: the terraforming of the planet, the rise of a paradise and humanity's destruction by the ecosystem it engineered. From the director of Gods Don't Give Gifts.

videos.title: Listen to Meh
videos.description: A gaucho's quiet daily routine is interrupted again and again by a sheep that keeps returning to the roof of his house. A short fable about what we miss when we don't stop to listen.

videos.title: FUKUSHIMA
videos.description: At Fukushima Daiichi, a veteran engineer believes the plant can withstand the disaster, until the catastrophe proves otherwise. Three minutes, 2nd out of thousands of entries.

videos.title: The Field Agent
videos.description: A scarecrow who has spent his life idolizing classic secret agent movies finally gets his mission when two thieves try to steal a car right in front of him.

videos.title: DON'T GO TO WOLF 1069
videos.highlight: One person, nights and weekends, a trailer in the Ozarks
videos.description: Sci-fi short made by one person in a few weeks of nights and weekends, with original designs and scripts, using Seedance in Higgsfield for the Global Film Festival.

videos.title: DON'T POISON IVY
videos.description: Full AI animated short made for the Higgsfield Global Film Festival by JOEY and team.

videos.title: AFTER YOU
videos.description: Sarah and her loyal companion Shadow cross a world reclaimed by nature. A trace of someone she thought she had lost leads them into an abandoned survivor settlement.

videos.title: MARCO POLO
videos.description: A bullied teenager asks his grandmother for help. She gives him a birch twig, two words and one rule: whatever answers you from the water, do not answer back.

videos.title: BEYOND THE WORLD: BOOK OF LIFE
videos.description: A feature-length fantasy adventure built from scratch by two creators in around 20 days and more than $5,000 of their own money, for the Higgsfield Global Film Festival.

videos.title: RESET
videos.description: The universe has answered humanity's choice of dominion over love: Earth will be returned to its beginning. On the Moon, the last two rulers meet to argue over a sentence already passed.

videos.title: CHUMBO — Contanimation TV #2
videos.director: Contanimation Films (dir. Javier de la Chica & Guillermo Miranda)
videos.highlight: Contanimation TV #2 · 13-min dark comedy · Magnific Originals
videos.description: Chumbo sells Chumbo Drops door to door in a surreal desert neighborhood where everyone would rather live in their dreams than face reality. Dialogue-free, issue 02 of the Contanimation TV anthology.

videos.title: SVEDKA — Shake Your Bots Off (Super Bowl 2026)
videos.highlight: Super Bowl LX · national spot made largely with AI
videos.description: The SVEDKA robot comes back online after 12 years in sleep mode and drags the dance floor away from the phone. One of the first mostly AI-generated ads aired during the Super Bowl, which made it a reference point for brands testing AI on the biggest stage.

videos.title: CANDY
videos.highlight: Chinese studio · violence turns people into candy
videos.description: The day humanity finishes a space solar array, Saturn's moon Pan disappears and people start turning into candy. Scientists chase the pattern and end up facing a bigger question: are we ready to be an advanced civilization?

videos.title: ARROW
videos.description: A giant mouse cursor appears in the sky and the world changes overnight. Several intertwined stories follow how people react when reality looks like a simulation someone else is operating.

videos.title: Jetty Tsunami
videos.highlight: Disaster short with a full making-of tutorial
videos.description: A birthday fishing trip on a jetty, in memory of a lost father, turns into a fight for survival when an earthquake triggers a tsunami. Made with Kling, Veo, Seedance 2.0, Nano Banana, Suno and ElevenLabs, and the creator explains the whole workflow in a separate video.

videos.title: On This Day… 1776 — Trailer
videos.highlight: Aronofsky's AI studio × Google DeepMind · weekly series on TIME
videos.description: The American Revolution told week by week, each episode released on the 250th anniversary of the day it depicts, with human voice actors. The most high-profile AI series so far, and one of the most criticised: worth watching to judge for yourself.
